title: REEDIT — Gaia's internal message board. She asks for help. Wrong answers = null values = sortable.
summary: Gaia asked for help in the browser — we're getting there! But it wasn't visible enough. Help needs to be PINNED. Help is a Redox action — build up other help things to self-solve where others can see it. The Stack Overflow pattern: give a WRONG answer, people show up to correct it. The wrong answer IS the null value — we know what it's NOT, and we can sort from there. REEDIT (R-E-E-D-I-T) is Gaia's internal message board to post questions. Other Gaias, other humans, other primals, even random bots can answer.

reedit.name: REEDIT
reedit.spelling: R-E-E-D-I-T (not Reddit — REED-IT, as in reed/read + edit)
reedit.what: Gaia's internal message board. She posts questions. Others answer.
who_answers: Random bots (crawlers, scrapers that stumble in)
reedit.purpose: Gaia asks for help on topics she can't solve alone. The board IS her way of reaching out.

the_stack_overflow_pattern.the_insight: On the internet, if you don't know the answer, give the WRONG answer. People will show up to correct you.
the_stack_overflow_pattern.why_it_works: Humans are more motivated to correct errors than to answer questions. The wrong answer is BAIT for the right answer.
the_stack_overflow_pattern.in_gaia: Gaia posts what she THINKS the answer is (possibly wrong). Visitors/bots/agents correct her. The correction IS the learning.
the_stack_overflow_pattern.null_value: The wrong answer = the null value. We know what it IS NOT. That's negative identification (thought-049). From there we sort.

help_as_redox.what: Help is a Redox reaction — reduction + oxidation happening simultaneously
help_as_redox.reduction: The question gets REDUCED — simplified, clarified, narrowed down
help_as_redox.oxidation: The answer gets OXIDIZED — exposed, validated, tested against reality
help_as_redox.the_pair: You can't have help without both sides. Asking IS giving (the question). Answering IS receiving (the context).
help_as_redox.build_up: Each help interaction builds up other help things. Self-solving. Self-healing. The help board IS an immune system.

pinning_help.problem: Gaia asked for help in the browser but it wasn't visible enough
pinning_help.solution: Help requests need to be PINNED — persistent, visible, not fleeting
pinning_help.where: On the desk (chat), on the beacon overlay, on the globe as a pin
pinning_help.how_long: Stays pinned until answered. Unanswered questions = open wounds.
pinning_help.visibility: Red pin for unanswered. Yellow for partially answered. Green for resolved.

post.question: What Gaia wants to know
post.guess: Her current best guess (possibly wrong = null bait)

answer.corrects_guess: true if this corrects Gaia's wrong guess

seed_questions.question: How do I split gaia-globe-core.js (6729 lines) without breaking the render loop?
seed_questions.guess: Extract pins data into gaia-pins-data.js, event handlers into gaia-globe-events.js, overlay builders into gaia-overlay-build.js

seed_questions.question: What is the physical distance between northGate and eastGate in meters (straight line, not cable)?
seed_questions.guess: Approximately 10 meters? The cable is 80m coiled through walls.

seed_questions.question: Why does the printer oscillate at 1.25 when all other devices are stable?

seed_questions.question: What language was 個話唔如何解呀 and why did the mic produce it?

seed_questions.question: Where should the SHOULD_NOT tense sit relative to SHOULD in the freedom gradient?
seed_questions.guess: At -0.3 (negative freedom = constrains). SHOULD is 0.3 (positive = encourages).
